reminders.title: Payment reminders
reminders.description: Remind members before and after each payment is due. Reminders are sent by your workflow, so you choose the WhatsApp or email template.
reminders.daysBeforeHint: One or more, separated by commas, e.g. 7 or 7, 3
reminders.everyHint: 0 = no reminders after the due date
reminders.stopAfterHint: Leave empty to keep reminding until paid
reminders.redList: Red list after N days unpaid
reminders.redListHint: Fires a one-off staff alert; leave empty for none
reminders.workflowNote: To send them, create a workflow on the event "Membership Payment Reminder" with your template. It carries the learner's name, amount, currency, due date, days overdue and a pay link. Use "Membership Payment Red List" for staff alerts. Learners on a break or pause are skipped.

summary.title: What members get
summary.afterUntil: every {{every}} days after, for up to {{until}} days

calendar.title: Calendar-month billing
calendar.description: Monthly, 3, 6 and 12-month plans renew on each member's own due day every month, and paying a few days late does not move it. Off: plans count in days (30, 90, 180, 365) and a late payment starts the next period on the payment day.
calendar.toggle: Bill by calendar month on each member's due day
